subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
One who is all powerful.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Omnipotent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Omnipotent"** refers to someone or something that is all-powerful or has unlimited power. (सर्वशक्तिमान)
 
 
• **Example:** Many religions describe God as an omnipotent being who controls the universe.
 
 
• **"Omniscient"** refers to someone who is all-knowing and possesses complete knowledge. (सर्वज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example:** An omniscient narrator knows every detail about the characters and events in a story.
 
 
• Hence, **"Omnipotent"** is the correct answer because it directly matches the meaning of "one who is all-powerful." (सर्वशक्तिमान)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Omnipotent**.

---

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Omniscient** (सर्वज्ञ): Refers to someone who knows everything. 
 
 
• **Example:** Philosophers often ponder whether an omniscient being can truly exist.
 
 
 
• **Omnipresent** (सर्वव्यापी): Refers to someone or something that is present everywhere at the same time. 
 
 
• **Example:** The internet has become an omnipresent tool in modern life.
 
 
 
• **Omnivorous** (सर्वभक्षी): Refers to someone or something that eats both plants and animals. 
 
 
• **Example:** Bears are omnivorous creatures that eat both berries and fish.
